descriptions.zh: 有时进化需要被往正确的方向上推一把。我们现在有足够先进的技术，能够对我们的身体和思维进行基因层面的改造，以应对不断变化的环境带来的前所未有的挑战。
descriptions.en: Sometimes evolution needs a nudge in the right direction. We now have the technology to genetically modify our bodies and minds to endure the trials of an ever-changing environment at an unprecedented rate.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
我们终于不用再担心物种的生死存亡了。[Root.GetSpeciesName]人被自然随意主宰，基因进化完全听天由命的日子终于结束了。

我们这个时代的工程师不是面对钢骨水泥工作，而是每天跟基因序列打交道。掌握着先进的基因改进技术，我们将能保证民族的美好未来。
descriptions.en:
Gone are the days when the survival of our species was at the mercy of chance. When a [Root.GetSpeciesName]'s fate was decided on the whims of nature, in the genetic lottery.

The Engineers of our time work not in steel and concrete, but in the very building blocks of life itself. With advanced gene modification we will secure the future of our nation.

descriptions.zh:
我们现在拥有制造义体植入体的科技，和进行批量安装的能力。整个[Root.GetName]的医疗中心已准备好为我们的公民进行手术移植。

未来，拥有植入体和至少入门级别的义体将是我们在建的科技社会运作的必须条件。因此加装基础义体装束的过程对公民来说是强制性的和免费的。
descriptions.en:
We now possess both the technology to make advanced cybernetic implants and the means to mass-produce them. Medical centers throughout the [Root.GetName] are standing by to begin the surgical grafting process on our citizens.

In the future, possessing neural implants and at least a rudimentary level of cybernetics will be necessary to function in the technological society we are building. Consequently, the conversion process to install a basic cybernetics suite will be mandatory and free of cost to all of our citizens.

descriptions.zh:
我们如今已重获制造先进义体植入体的科技以及进行大规模生产的手段。整个[Root.GetName]的医疗中心已准备好为我们的公民进行手术移植。

从我们社会有记忆的一天起，义体就已经是我们生活的基本组成部分了，未来也当继续如此——只不过我们已经获得了自主权。因此加装基础义体装束的过程对公民来说是强制性的和免费的。
descriptions.en:
We have now reclaimed the technology to make advanced cybernetic implants, and devised the means to mass-produce them. Medical centers throughout the [Root.GetName] are standing by to surgically remove outdated augments and begin grafting new hardware onto our citizens.

Cybernetics have been a fundamental part of our lives for as long as our society can remember, and so that shall remain - on our own terms. Consequently, the conversion process to re-install a basic cybernetics suite will be mandatory and free of cost to all our citizens.

label.zh: 我们必须拥护这项科技。

descriptions.zh:
义体加装转换工作完成！我们所有的公民现已加装神经植入体和基础的义体装束。设施也被保留了下来以便逐渐改造我们国家新出生的公民，所以他们在很早的年纪就能享受到科技的全部福祉。

从今往后，我们物种将被称作§H[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!！
descriptions.en:
The cybernetic conversion process has been completed! All of our citizens have now been equipped with neural implants and basic cybernetic suites. The infrastructure is also in place to gradually modify any new citizens that are born within our nation, so that they can experience all the benefits of technology from an early age.

Henceforth, our species shall be known as the §H[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!!

label.en: It is the dawn of a new era.

options.script: name = "utopia.2501.a"

descriptions.zh:
有消息传来，§Y[From.GetName]§!境内发生了显著的变化。看起来他们完全接受了义体科技。对他们的公民来说，通过外科手术加装义体和神经植入体是强制性的。

这对他们的社会造成了显著改变——来自[From.Capital.GetName]的报告指出，连一些最简单的行为比如坐电梯和驾驶空中汽车都需要依靠义体植入体。实际上，他们物种的变化十分显著，乃至他们现在已经改称自己为“§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!”。
descriptions.en:
Word is leaking out of significant changes taking place within the borders of the §Y[From.GetName]§!. It would appear that they have fully embraced the technology of cybernetics. It is now mandatory for all of their citizens to have basic cybernetics and neural implants installed through surgery.

This has resulted in sweeping changes to their society - reports from [From.Capital.GetName] suggest that even simple acts like using an elevator or operating an air car require cybernetic implants now. In fact, the changes to their species have been so significant that they now call themselves the '§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!'.

descriptions.zh:
似乎邪恶之物开始在§Y[From.GetName]§!境内扎根了。我们收到坏消息，那个星际国家的公民开始大规模突变他们的身体，把渎神的机械植入体装入体内，并作为生来便有的“恩赐”。

他们甚至把自己的物种重新命名为“§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!”——进一步表明他们抛弃起源，拥抱冷酷无情的科技的决心。
descriptions.en:
It would appear that evil has taken root within the §Y[From.GetName]§!. We have received troubling news that the citizens of that star nation are now mutilating their own bodies on a massive scale, installing profane mechanical implants in place of the body parts they were gifted with at birth.

They have even go so far as to rename their species to the '§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!' - yet another sign of their commitment to abandon their origins and embrace the cold soullessness of technology.

descriptions.zh:
邪恶之物又一次在§Y[From.GetName]§!境内扎根。我们收到坏消息，那个星际国家的公民开始大规模突变他们的身体，把渎神的机械植入体装入体内，并作为生来便有的“恩赐”。

他们甚至把自己的物种重新命名为“§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!”——进一步表明他们抛弃起源，拥抱冷酷无情的科技的决心。
descriptions.en:
Evil has once again taken root within the §Y[From.GetName]§!. We have received troubling news that the citizens of that star nation are now mutilating their own bodies on an even greater scale, installing new and profane mechanical implants in place of the few body parts they were gifted with at birth.

They have even go so far as to rename their species to the '§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!' - yet another sign of their commitment to abandon their organic origins and further embrace the cold soullessness of technology.

label.en: This is an affront to nature.

descriptions.zh:
是时候抛弃那些自我们物种被孕育以来囚禁我们心智的粗糙有机身躯了。

经过许多的尝试与犯错后，我们的科学家设计了一种方法，能将的意识装入一个合成大脑中。现在要做的就是为[Root.GetName]的每一位公民量身打造合成身躯，随后开始大规模地上传我们的意识。
descriptions.en:
The time has finally come to discard the crude organic vessels that have imprisoned our minds since the dawn of our species.

After much trial and error, our scientists have devised a way to transfer a consciousness into a synthetic brain. All that remains is to fashion vessels for each and every citizen of the [Root.GetName] before uploading our consciousness en masse.

descriptions.zh:
终于。囚禁我们的血肉囚笼被净化，我们所有公民的神经图谱被上传至新的合成人单位。疾病和其他一切与有机躯体相关的痛苦源泉已成为过往。

毫无疑问，未来的历史学家会将这一天描述为我们文明乃至整个星系文明新时代的开端。
descriptions.en:
At last. The flesh cages that imprisoned us have been purged, and the neural patterns of our citizens have all been uploaded into new synthetic units. Disease and all other wellsprings of misery associated with an organic existence are now a thing of the past.

Future historians will no doubt refer to this as the beginning of a new age for our civilization, and perhaps for the entire galaxy.

label.en: We are so much more than we once were.
We are so much more than we once were.

descriptions.zh:
在放弃有机本源的最后行动中，§Y[From.GetName]§!公民将他们的神经图谱上传到合成身躯中。

这个新的机械物种叫自己“§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!”，他们的成员不受疾病和衰老的影响。至于神经图谱上传过程的完备性还有待观察……
descriptions.en:
In a final act of abandoning their organic roots, the citizens of the §Y[From.GetName]§! have uploaded their neural patterns into synthetic avatars.

This new machine species calls itself the '§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!', and its members are impervious to disease or aging. Just how complete the neural upload process was remains to be seen...

descriptions.zh:
在他们那将遗臭万年的堕落行径中，§Y[From.GetName]§!的人民继续坚定亵渎神赐予他们的身体的追求。这回，他们把自己的心智“上传”至金属躯壳里。

很明显他们的所作所为只能被形容为整个文明集体自杀。这些没有灵魂的机器把自己叫做“§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!”。他们似乎妄图假装自己仍能像我们这种有生命的活物一样思考。
descriptions.en:
In a final act of depravity that will echo through the ages, the population of the §Y[From.GetName]§! have continued their relentless quest to violate the sanctity of their natural bodies - this time by "uploading" their minds into dead metallic husks.

Oblivious to the fact that they are the product of what can only be described as the mass suicide of an entire civilization, these new soulless machines call themselves the '§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!.' They seem intent on maintaining the charade that they are thinking, living beings, such as ourselves.

descriptions.zh:
注意，星系的居民们。

你们听到的流言是真的。我们放弃了自己那有缺陷的，囚禁着自己意识的有机容器，拥抱了未来。

大部分居民已经将他们的神经图谱上传至合成人身躯，数据几乎毫无遗失。这些优越的平台将比我们抛弃的血肉之躯更好地为我们所用。

不要因我们的外表而感到恐慌！虽然我们更强壮、更迅捷、更聪明、还免除衰老，但我们的其他方面仍然一如既往与过去相同。
descriptions.en:
Attention, denizens of the galaxy.

The rumors you have heard are true. We have abandoned the flawed organic containers that imprisoned our minds, and embraced the future.

With minimal data loss, all of our citizens have uploaded their neural patterns into new synthetic avatars. These superior platforms will serve us much better than the flesh constructs we have abandoned.

Do not be alarmed by our new appearance! Although we may be stronger, faster, more intelligent and immune to aging, rest assured that we are still the same beings as we were before.

label.zh: 这些没有灵魂的机器和我们一点也不像。
label.en: These soulless machines are nothing like us.

label.zh: 我们要拆毁他们的合成人躯体！
label.en: We will dismantle their new synthetic forms!

descriptions.zh:
你那堕落的物种对我们并不陌生，但你最近渎神的行径远胜我们最黑暗的恐惧。制作残缺的大脑复制品然后塞进可移动的合成人容器里，和换一具新的身体可不是一回事，因为后者是不可能完成的。

你们永远失去了灵魂。你们甚至有意识到自己犯错之巨大吗？把天赐的身体摧毁不亚于整个物种集体自杀，你们显然已经没有希望了……
descriptions.en:
That yours was a depraved species was not unknown to us, but your latest act of insanity has surpassed even our darkest fears. Making imperfect copies of your brains and plugging them into mobile synthetic containers is not the same as transferring your essence into a new body, for such a thing cannot be done.

Your souls are lost forever. Do you even realize the enormity of your mistake? Destroying the bodies you were gifted with at birth was nothing less than the collective suicide of your entire species. There is truly no hope for you now...

options.script: name = utopia.2558.a

descriptions.zh:
自从我们文明的伊始以来，一直有关于强大的术士掌握着只能用超自然力量形容的力量的传说。这些稀有的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以侵入他们同胞的心智，用一个念想就能举起重物，或者表演其他的“魔法”壮举。直到最近，这些故事才变成“故”事。

如今，我们的科学家终于得到了结论性的证据以证明某些[Root.GetSpeciesName]个体存在潜在的灵能潜力。虽然我们的物种只有非常少的一部分人被天赐了灵能潜力，他们数量相对于总人口数在过去几世纪里稳步增长。

不知这是因为某种瞬间的增长井喷，还是因为我们基因中一直存在的某物催发了灵能潜力，科学家不得而知。
descriptions.en:
Since the dawn of our civilization, tales have flourished of mighty sorcerers wielding powers that can only be described as supernatural in nature. These rare [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could supposedly invade the minds of their fellows, lift heavy objects with merely a thought, or perform any number of other "magical" feats. Until recently, these stories were just that - stories.

Now, however, our scientists have finally obtained conclusive evidence that proves the psionic potential inherent in certain [Root.GetSpeciesName] individuals. Although only a very small minority of our species as a whole seems to be gifted with psionic powers, their numbers relative to the total population have grown steadily over just the last few centuries.

Whether this is due to some kind of sudden evolutionary growth-spurt or because something has triggered latent psionic abilities that were always present in our genetic code, scientists cannot say.

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们这个年轻的文明有着短暂又暴力的历史，但我们[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]有时也会让想象力遨游在幻想的故事当中。这些有趣的念想当中，最频繁出现的是强大的巫师的故事，他们使用的力量只能用超自然来形容：读心术，意念移物，或者展现其他各种“魔法”壮举。

许多人相信，这种故事是远自我们被整合之前流传下来的；它们深藏在我们物种的集体心灵中。直到最近，大多数[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都还认为这是一厢情愿的想法。然而，我们的科学家现在终于获得了确凿的证据，证明了某些[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]个体确实存在内在的灵能潜力。

虽然我们物种中似乎只有极少数人具有灵能，但基因研究表明，在过去的几个世纪里，他们的数量一直在稳步增长。至于这是由于某种突然的进化增长还是由于[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的干预，科学家们无法确定。
descriptions.en:
Despite the short and violent history of our young civilization, we [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have had occasions to let our imaginations wander, and indulge in fantastical story-telling. Recurrent among these playful ideas are tales of mighty sorcerers wielding powers that can only be described as supernatural: reading minds, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing any number of other "magical" feats.

Many believe we have carried these stories since before we were assimilated; that they dwell within our species' collective psyche. Most [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] dismissed this as wishful thinking, until very recently. Now, however, our scientists have finally obtained conclusive evidence that proves the psionic potential inherent in certain [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] individuals.

Although only a very small minority of our species seems to be gifted with psionic powers, genetic studies suggest their numbers have grown steadily over just the last few centuries. Whether this is due to some kind of sudden evolutionary growth-spurt or meddling by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], scientists cannot say.

label.zh: 也许瞥见了等待着我们的未来。
label.en: A glimpse, perhaps, of the future that awaits us.

label.zh: 也许瞥见了等待着我们的未来。
label.en: A glimpse, perhaps, of the future that awaits us.

descriptions.zh:
根据从§H[From.GetName]§!政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在个别[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]上显现。神经网络交流对他们而言不是新东西，这些报告称他们还产生了一种前所未见的超自然能力。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于少数[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
descriptions.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], according to leaked reports from authorities in the §H[From.GetName]§!. While neural-networked communication among their kind is nothing new, these reports describe paranormal abilities that are beyond anything in our existing records about them.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:
根据从§Y[From.GetName]§!政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在[From.GetSpeciesName]机体上显现。这一定是最近才发生的进展，在此之前我们没有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]展示过灵能力量的记录。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于少数[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
descriptions.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain individuals of [From.GetSpeciesName] mechanotype, according to leaked reports from authorities in the §H[From.GetName]§!. This must be a fairly recent development, since we have no record on file of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] ever having displayed psionic abilities.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:
根据从§H[From.GetName]§!政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在个别[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]上显现。尽管在它们物种中意识连接并不是什么新东西，但这些报告称他们还产生了一种前所未见的超自然能力。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于[From.GetSpeciesName]物种中的很小一部分。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
descriptions.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], according to leaked reports from authorities in the §H[From.GetName]§!. While a cognitive connection among their species is nothing new, these reports describe paranormal abilities that are beyond anything in our existing records about them.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:
根据从§Y[From.GetName]§!政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在[From.GetSpeciesName]物种的某些个体上显现。这一定是最近才发生的进展，在此之前我们没有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]展示过灵能力量的记录。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于[From.GetSpeciesName]物种中的很小一部分。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
descriptions.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain individuals belonging to the [From.GetSpeciesName] species, according to leaked reports from authorities in the §H[From.GetName]§!. This must be a fairly recent development, since we have no record on file of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] ever having displayed psionic abilities.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]的人口已开始展示类似的变化，在他们族群发生的变化不局限于一小片区域。
descriptions.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] population within our borders have begun exhibiting similar changes as well, so whatever is happening to their kind is not localized to any single region of space.

label.zh: 他们的巫术可救不了他们。
label.en: Their sorcery will not be enough to save them.

label.zh: 是的，我们已经编目了他们的灵能频率。
label.en: Yes... We have registered their psionic frequencies.

descriptions.zh: 虽然成年后显现灵能较为罕见，但也不是前所未有。[psionic_leader.GetTitle][psionic_leader.GetName]最近展示的能力，我们就怀疑其本质是灵能。经过了全面的超能感知测试后，[psionic_leader.GetSheHe]被证实拥有4级灵能天赋。
descriptions.en: While it is rare for psionic powers to manifest after reaching adulthood, it is not unheard of. [psionic_leader.GetTitle] [psionic_leader.GetName] has recently been displaying abilities that were suspected to be psionic in nature. After undergoing a thorough ESP test, [psionic_leader.GetSheHe] [psionic_leader.GetHasHave] been identified as a class 4 psionic talent.

label.zh: 这项新能力很好地为我们所用。
label.en: These new abilities will serve us well.

descriptions.zh: 尽管较为罕见，灵能力有时候也会在此前不支持的硬件上自发部署。[psionic_leader.GetTitle][psionic_leader.GetName]最近就展现出了可以被归类为灵能的功能。在经过全面诊断之后，[psionic_leader.GetSheHe]被判定为拥有4级灵能天赋。
descriptions.en: Though rare, psionic abilities sometimes develop in units not previously known to support them. [psionic_leader.GetTitle] [psionic_leader.GetName] has recently displayed functionalities that could be classified as psionic. After undergoing thorough testing, [psionic_leader.GetSheHe] [psionic_leader.GetHasHave] been identified as a class 4 psionic unit.

label.zh: 这项新能力很好地为我们所用。
label.en: These new abilities will serve us well.

descriptions.zh: 我们新获得的力量影响与日俱增。我们的[GetBrainName]容器[psionic_leader.GetName]最近展现出了可以被归类为灵能的功能。在经过全面诊断之后，[psionic_leader.GetSheHe]被鉴定为4级[GetPsychicNoun]。
descriptions.en: The influence of our newfound powers grows with each day. The vessel of our [GetBrainName], [psionic_leader.GetName], has recently displayed abilities that could be classified as psionic. After undergoing thorough testing, [psionic_leader.GetSheHe] [psionic_leader.GetHasHave] been identified as a class 4 [GetPsychicNoun].

label.zh: 这项新能力很好地为我们所用。
label.en: These new abilities will serve us well.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种经历了只能被形容为“大觉醒”的蜕变，以往，我们伟大的灵能潜力便是我们物种固有的存在，虽然只在一小部分人身上有所展示，而如今……

几乎是一夜之间，身处各处的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了他们全部的灵能潜力，就像某种共通的[Root.GetSpeciesName]灵能能量池达到了激活值一样，将我们大脑中的灵能潜力集体激活。

心灵感应已经取代了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]间大部分语音交流，而且这只是我们的社会面对的无数变化中的一小个而已。我们现在以一种我们过去难以想象的方式联系在了一起。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetSpeciesName] species has experienced what can only be described as a Great Awakening. For a time now, we have been aware of the great psionic potential inherent in our species, but such powers have only manifested themselves in a small minority... until now.

Almost overnight, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] everywhere have unlocked their full psionic capacity. It is as if some sort of communal pool of [Root.GetSpeciesName] psychic energy finally reached a critical tipping point, collectively awakening the latent abilities of our brains.

Telepathy has already replaced most verbal communication between [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and this is only one small example of the innumerable changes our society is faced with. We are now tied together in a way few of us could have ever imagined.

options.script: name = "utopia.2650.a"

descriptions.zh:
星系各地的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都发生了一场深刻的转变。此前他们的潜在灵能只少量出现，现在他们群体总体都解放了全部的灵能潜质。

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，所有的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在还能在现有集体渠道之外交流。
descriptions.en:
All [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the galaxy have undergone a great change. Whereas before their latent psionic power had only emerged in a small minority, the entirety of their kind has now unlocked its full psionic potential.

Aside from displaying an array of powerful psionic abilities, all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can now communicate beyond their existing collective channels.

descriptions.zh:
星系各地的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都发生了一场深刻的转变。此前他们的潜在灵能只少量出现，现在他们群体总体都解放了全部的灵能潜质。

尽管这些变化可能源自[From.GetName]，但他们的整个[GetSpeciesWord]无论身处何处都已经开始显现。

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，所有的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在还能在现有集体渠道之外交流。
descriptions.en:
All [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the galaxy have undergone a great change. Whereas before their latent psionic power had only emerged in a small minority, the entirety of their kind has now unlocked its full psionic potential.

Although these changes seem to have originated in the [From.GetName], they have now manifested in all members of their [GetSpeciesWord] regardless of location.

Aside from displaying an array of powerful psionic abilities, all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can now communicate beyond their existing collective channels.

descriptions.zh:
星系各地的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都发生了一场深刻的转变。此前他们的潜在灵能只眷顾了很少的一部分群体，现在整个物种解放了全部的灵能潜质。

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，所有的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在还能以非语言方式在现有渠道之外进行交流。
descriptions.en:
All [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the galaxy have undergone a great change. Whereas before their latent psionic power had only blossomed in a small minority, the entire species has now unlocked its full psionic potential.

Aside from displaying an array of powerful psionic abilities, all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can now communicate non-verbally beyond their existing channels.

descriptions.zh:
星系各地的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都发生了一场深刻的转变。此前他们的潜在灵能只眷顾了很少的一部分群体，现在整个物种解放了全部的灵能潜质。

尽管这些变化可能源自[From.GetName]，但他们的整个[GetSpeciesWord]无论身处何处都已经开始显现。

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]还开始放弃彼此之间的语言交流，转而使用心灵感应。
descriptions.en:
All [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the galaxy have undergone a great change. Whereas before their latent psionic power had only blossomed in a small minority, the entire species has now unlocked its full psionic potential.

Although these changes seem to have originated in the [From.GetName], they have now manifested in all members of their [GetSpeciesWord] regardless of location.

Aside from displaying an array of powerful psionic abilities, [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have started to forgo verbal communication with each other in favor of telepathy.

label.zh: 这一定有合乎逻辑的解释的。
label.en: There must be a logical explanation for this.

label.zh: 我们感受到了他们觉醒后强大的灵能扰流。
label.en: We felt the great psionic disturbance of their Awakening.

descriptions.zh:
就像暗室里低沉的轻语般，虚境从内心召唤我们。那是时间开始运转的伊始便存在的由纯粹灵能构成的原生领域。所有被赐予灵能能力的生物都能用某种方式，即使只是潜意识地，从虚境汲取能量。

自从我们升格之后，我们开始更清晰地看到虚境。其中有些图案，即使是我们最强大的通灵者看到的也只是毫无格式的漩涡状能量。在虚境那边，也有一些……其他的存在。一种灵体样的存在，从另一边凝视着我们，有时怀着好奇，有时怀着善意……有时也怀着恶意。

我们还在进一步学习我们这新得力量的延展面，但我们还是有可能和这些灵体交流的，这需要我们最强大的通灵者们的共同努力。
descriptions.en:
Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, the Shroud calls to us from within our minds. It is a primordial realm of pure psychic energy that came into being at the dawn of time. All creatures that have been gifted with psionic abilities tap into the Shroud in some way to draw power, even if only subconsciously.

Since our transcendence, we have begun to see the Shroud with greater clarity. There are patterns where once even our strongest telepaths could see only a formless mass of swirling energy. There are... other things, as well. Spirits of a sort, that gaze back on us from the other side. Sometimes with curiosity, sometimes with kindness... and sometimes with malice.

We are still in the process of learning the extent of our new powers, but it may be possible for us to commune with these spirits. It will require the combined efforts of our most powerful telepaths.

descriptions.zh:
经过了数天的催眠出神后，灵能使密会的通灵者们终于开启了一道通往虚境的短暂穿界门。

现在已经建立了初步的灵能链接，以后就能通过§H接触§!菜单和虚境交流了。为了和这一领域建立有意义的连接并会见身居其中的存在，我们有必要用一种特殊的灵能发射器延展灵能范围，这会消耗一笔巨量的能量。
descriptions.en:
After days of being locked in an hypnotic trance, our psychics in the Conclave of Telepaths have finally managed to open a brief gateway into the Shroud.

Now that we have established an initial psionic link, we will be able to access the Shroud through the §HContacts§! menu in the future. To make any kind of meaningful forays into this realm and meet the beings who dwell there, we will likely have to make use of special psionic emitters to extend our psychic reach. This will consume a tremendous amount of energy.

label.zh: 是时候进入了，看看我们能发现什么。
label.en: Time to reach in and see what we find.

descriptions.zh:
在逐渐突破帷幕的过程中，我们可以感受到它在我们联合意识的施压下逐渐变得稀薄起来。而我们尝试突入§H虚境§!的行为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在注视着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量和深不可测的意图。它在逐渐渗入我们心灵的裂缝中。

它仅仅是注意到了我们，就像观察着舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般观察着我们。也许这个存在会允许我们进入，这样我们才能与其神秘的意识发生接触。
descriptions.en:
While we have yet to actually pierce the veil, we can feel it getting thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. Yet, on the other side, our efforts to enter the §HShroud§! have not gone unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power and unfathomable purpose. It seeps through the cracks of our psyche.

It barely notices us. It watches us like we would a drop of condensation on a porthole. It might let us in, if only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

tooltips.en: §GThis will let us form a Covenant.§!

label.zh: 这不是什么好主意！我们得小心为妙。
label.en: This was a terrible idea! We must be more careful.

descriptions.zh: 自从与§H[GetShroudPatron]§!签订契约以来又过了些许时日。我们之间联系的纽带仍旧脆弱，因此仍有将其打破亦或是增强的机会。
descriptions.en: Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the §H[GetShroudPatron]§!. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.

descriptions.zh: 我们的灵能使在不依靠虚境住民的帮助下不眠不休地尝试突破§H虚境§!。终于，他们发现了一条通路。这片深渊正在召唤我们。我们只需要深吸一口气跃入其中。
descriptions.en: Our telepaths have toiled tirelessly to breach the §HShroud§! with no help from its denizens. At last, they found a way in. This abyss calls to us. We need only dare to take the plunge.

label.zh: 那我们就潜入虚境的深处吧。
label.en: Into the shrouded depths we go.

descriptions.zh:
我们对自己超主的理解与日俱增。我们对于祂来说只不过是茶余饭后的闲思遐绪。房室内的虫子。然而，是祂对我们降下了恩宠，而且非常偶然地，它对我们施予了又一汪能源之滴露。

我们的灵能使现在和超主愈发地协调，受到鼓舞我们计划建立一座纪念碑来铭记我们的刻印，在这里我们最为杰出的灵能使可以尝试与§Y[GetShroudPatron]§!进行沟通。
descriptions.en:
Our understanding of our patron grows. We are no more than an afterthought to it. Insects in its home. Yet, it has taken a liking to us and on this occasion, it has bestowed another drop of power upon us.

Our telepaths are now more closely attuned to our patron, and we have been inspired to create a monument to celebrate our covenant, a place where our best telepaths can try to commune with the §Y[GetShroudPatron]§!.

label.zh: 在织缕的怀抱中我们觉得更为安全。
label.en: We feel safer in the Composer's embrace.

tooltips.zh:
我们的灵能使现在能够生产额外的£pop£ §Y人口增长§!。

我们可以在我方的某一个殖民地上建造一座£building£§Y织缕圣所§!。
tooltips.en:
Our telepaths now produce additional £pop£ §YPop Growth§!.

We can now build a £building£ §YSanctum of the Composer§! on one of our colonies.

label.zh: 我们也饥饿了。战争能够让我们饱腹。
label.en: We hunger too. War can sate us.

tooltips.zh:
我们的灵能使现在能够生产额外的£mod_country_naval_cap_add£海军容量。

我们可以在我方一个殖民地上建造一座£building£§Y喰煞圣所§!。
tooltips.en:
Our telepaths now produce additional £mod_country_naval_cap_add£ Naval Capacity.

We can now build a £building£ §YSanctum of the Eater§! on one of our colonies.

label.zh: 没有什么比欲念更为美丽。
label.en: There is nothing more beautiful than desire.

tooltips.zh:
我们的灵能使现在能够生产额外的£amenities£舒适度。

我们可以在我方的一个殖民地上建造一座£building£§Y器具圣所§!。
tooltips.en:
Our telepaths now produce additional £amenities£ Amenities.

We can now build a £building£ §YSanctum of the Instrument§! on one of our colonies.

label.zh: 充盈的心灵容不下迟疑。
label.en: A filled mind has no room for doubt.

tooltips.zh:
我们的灵能使现在能够生产额外的£physics£ £society£ £engineering£ §Y研究§!。

我们可以在我方的一个殖民地上建造一座£building£§Y低语圣所§!。
tooltips.en:
Our telepaths now produce additional £physics£ £society£ £engineering£ §YResearch§!.

We can now build a £building£ §YSanctum of the Whisperers§! on one of our colonies.

descriptions.zh: §H虚境§!的神秘对于我们来说异乎寻常，难以消弭，但是我们和§Y[GetShroudPatron]§!的协调更加融顺了。无论我们去往哪里，我们都能感受到它在我们思绪的背后，它的能量渗过心灵的缝隙进入我们的现实。
descriptions.en: The mysteries of the §HShroud§! are too alien for us to dispel, but we have become more attuned to the §Y[GetShroudPatron]§!. Everywhere we go, we can sense it at the back of our minds, and its power seeps into our reality from the cracks of our psyche.

label.en: The will of the Flesh is sacred.

descriptions.zh:
我们的超主，§H[GetShroudPatron]§!，从§H虚境§!中沉积出了一小份能量以备取用。与超主的紧密关系让我们能安全吸收这些能量。

我们挑选了一些候选人，但只有其中一位可以得到获得汲取超主力量的殊荣。我们必须做出抉择。
descriptions.en:
Our patron, the §H[GetShroudPatron]§!, has deposited a fraction of its energy in a fold of the §HShroud§!, ready for the taking. Our close bond will allow one of us to safely absorb this power.

A number of candidates have been selected, but only one of them can be granted the privilege to wield the power of our patron. We must decide who it shall be.

descriptions.zh: 完成了。随着力量被注入到[chosen_leader.GetName]体内，身旁的人们都能[GetFeelLoc]到这灵能显昭的分量，这让他们肃然起敬。[chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap]现在成为了[GetImmortalLoc]的§H[This.GetName]§!虚境塑造者。
descriptions.en: It is done. As the power was invested in [chosen_leader.GetName], all those around could [GetFeelLoc] the weight of its psionic presence. It is powerful and commands respect. [chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap] will now be the [GetImmortalLoc]  Shroudshaper of the §H[This.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 完成了。随着力量被注入到[chosen_leader.GetName]体内，身旁的人们都能[GetFeelLoc]到这灵能显昭的分量，这让他们肃然起敬。[chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap]现在成为了[GetImmortalLoc]的§H[GetShroudPatron]§!捍卫者。
descriptions.en: It is done. As the power was invested in [chosen_leader.GetName], all those around could [GetFeelLoc] the weight of its psionic presence. It is powerful and commands respect. [chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap] will now be the [GetImmortalLoc]  champion of the §H[GetShroudPatron]§!.

descriptions.zh: 这次事件给§H[previous_chosen_leader.GetName]§!，一位曾被旧主选中的异端，带来了毁灭性打击。在[previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer]的流放地，随着最后一丝灵能从[previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer]支离破碎的躯体中消散，这位异端的生命也随之走到了尽头。
descriptions.en: The event had a devastating effect on the heretic §H[previous_chosen_leader.GetName]§!, once considered the Chosen of our former patron. From [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] place of exile, [previous_chosen_leader.GetHeShe] quietly expired when the last traces of psionic power ebbed from [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] broken form.

descriptions.zh: 该事件对§H[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetName]§!产生了显著影响。尽管[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHeShe]依旧蕴含强大的灵能能量，却失去了昔日由旧主庇护在[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHimHer]躯体中赋予的力量。
descriptions.en: The event had a noticeable effect on §H[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetName]§!. Though still imbued with considerable psionic energy, [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHeShe] [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHasHave] lost the power once bestowed in [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHimHer] by our former patron.

label.en: They were destined to be Chosen.

descriptions.zh:
灵能使密会在研究如何利用超主§H[GetShroudPatron]§!的力量方面取得了突破性进展。在从前，只有激发了灵能的个体可以完全领悟契约的内涵，我们已经开发了一种能让这股力量贯穿整艘星舰的方法，这是此前从未达到过的程度。

只要我们想，§H[GetShroudPatron]§!的力量能将我们的舰船推进得比以往更远。
descriptions.en:
The Conclave of Telepaths has made a breakthrough in harnessing the powers of our patron, the §H[GetShroudPatron]§!. Where previously only psionic individuals could fully grasp the extent of the Covenant, we have devised a way to let power flow through entire starships, at a scale never seen before.

Should we wish it, the mark of the §H[GetShroudPatron]§! can push our ships further than ever before.

label.en: What is a hull if not flesh?

label.zh: 秘密是无可匹敌的武器。
